name: ANMLAqua-dolphin-eldora-20240224
description:
The sound of dolphin using echolocation as it chases a fish. At 35 seconds, the dolphin lets out a whistle. Snapping shrimp can be heard in the background throughout.

Recorded at Canaveral National Seashore by Nathan Wolek & Julian Rocha.
Captured with Zoom F6 recorder and Ambient hydrophones.

name: G12-15-Dolphins Underwater.wav
description: Sounds produced by a marine animal underwater. Dolphins whistling, whining, squealing. Burst-pulsed sounds.

name: [life_is] 116BPM Reason Rack guitar jam (acoustic)
description:
-recorded 31st MARCH 2025
-using Reason Rack as a plugin in FL Studio
-acoustic guitar > SM57(?) > Tascam M-106 > Focusrite Scarlett 2i2 Gen4 
-some whistling and talking at the end adding ambiance and sonar that made me think back to playing Ecco the Dolphin for the SEGA
-was probably just testing signal flow and saturation textures achievable through the scream module
